'''Ryloth's third moon''',<ref name="Lords of the Sith" /> also known as its '''Third Moon''',<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was the third [[moon]] in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]]. A desolate, rocky moon with a breathable [[atmosphere]], it was the closest of Ryloth's three moons. Shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] members of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] arranged a rendezvous there to pick up illegal weapons they had purchased.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

==Description==
[[Ryloth]]'s third [[moon]] was a desolate, rocky body with an [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s and [[Twi'lek]]s. From a distance, the moon appeared as a hazy grey sphere.<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> One of three moons orbiting Ryloth,<ref name="Resistance Reborn">''[[Resistance Reborn]]''</ref> it was located in the [[Ryloth system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]'<ref name="Databank" /> [[Gaulus sector]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> at [[Standard Galactic Grid|grid coordinates]] R-17. Like its [[planet]], the moon was located on the [[Corellian Run]]<ref name="TFA BG" /> and [[Mumble's Turnaround]] [[hyperspace route]]s.<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" /> The [[Twi'lek]] holiday known as [[Longest Night]] occurred when this moon and the [[Ryloth's outermost moon|two]] [[Ryloth's largest moon|other]] moons of Ryloth were at their lowest phase.<ref name="Resistance Reborn" />

==History==
[[File:RylothSystem-DD.png|thumb|left|300px|Ryloth and another of its moons seen from the surface of the third moon.]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars]] came to an end with the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganization]] of the ancient [[Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire]]. Although the change was claimed to be a return to peace, prosperity, and safety for the [[galaxy]], the truth was that it was a meticulously planned seizure of power by the new [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Some saw through the façade immediately and began to plan against the Empire. Former [[Twi'lek]] freedom fighter [[General]] [[Cham Syndulla]], who had fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Battle of Ryloth|invasion]] of Ryloth during the war, was not initially among them, as he wanted peace for his [[homeworld]] and for his daughter [[Hera Syndulla|Hera]] to not have to live a life of fighting. Cham's [[lieutenant]] [[Gobi Glie]] was suspicious, however, believing that his general was seeing what he wanted to see, and began [[Free Ryloth Movement|organizing]] with other former fighters. Glie also brought Hera into his group, believing that she should be prepared to fight.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

The Empire had requested that the Twi'leks disarm and turn in their weaponry, promising that their [[Imperial Military|military]] would protect Ryloth. Believing this left them vulnerable, Glie arranged to purchase more weapons from the [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], with a rendezvous scheduled on the third moon. When Glie and [[Serin]] were preparing to leave in [[Gobi Glie's starship|Glie's]] [[Rainhawk-class transport|''Rainhawk''-class transport]], Hera initially turned down an offer to come along as she had recently been caught trespassing near the new [[Imperial doonium refinery]]. However, she changed her mind when Glie said he had been going to let her fly. When the [[starship]] took off, however, the [[Elite Squad Trooper]] [[Commander]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]], who had been spying on the [[Hangar|landing pad]], tagged it with a [[homing beacon]].<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

Hera flew the [[transport]] most of the way to the moon, but Glie had Serin take over for landing as he believed that Hera was not yet experienced enough to handle takeoffs and landings. Serin checked the ship's [[sensor]]s and reported that their contact was already approaching, before they landed in a small plain on the moon. Scaleback had sent the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]],<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> a [[squad]] of former [[clone commando]]s who now worked for her as [[Mercenary|mercenaries]],<ref name="Rampage">{{TBB|Rampage (episode)}}</ref> to deliver the weapons, and their [[shuttle]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], flew in over the nearby hills before swinging around for a landing. The [[Cloning|clones]] disembarked, bringing along the crates of [[blaster]]s and [[thermal detonator]]s Scaleback had sent.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

While [[Hunter]] talked to Glie, who wanted to inspect the weapons before handing over payment, Hera wandered over to the ''Marauder'', curious. She asked [[Omega]],<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> a young clone who had joined the Batch when they [[Escape from Kamino|defected]] from the Empire,<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref> about the ship, and the girl got permission from Hunter to show Hera around. Once Glie and Serin had inspected the weapons to their satisfaction, he handed over the case with the payment to Hunter, telling him to tell Scaleback to let him know when she had more to sell. Hunter commented that building up an arsenal would attract attention and that Glie had better know what he was getting into, and Glie replied that he had no choice. Hera and Omega disembarked the ''Marauder'' as Glie called that they had to leave, and Hera said goodbye to Omega before running back to the Rainhawk. When Hunter asked Omega if she had made a new friend, Omega said she liked Hera but thought she was a bit strange. The Twi'leks departed the moon and returned to Ryloth, but were ambushed by Imperial forces due to the homing beacon planted on their ship.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

The Free Ryloth Movement maintained an [[Free Ryloth Movement underground base|underground base]] on the moon<ref name="Lords of the Sith" /> for years after.<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' to [[14 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1]], including the episode "[[Devil's Deal]]," in [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the base existing in during the events of ''Lords of the Sith'' means it has existed for years after the events of "Devil's Deal."</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ryloth's third moon first appeared in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Lords of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Lords of the Sith" /> It was later identified in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Devil's Deal]]."<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> The official [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry for [[Gobi Glie's starship]] refers to it as "Ryloth's moon" as if it were the only one,<ref name="Gobi Ship DB">{{Databank|gobi-glie-s-starship|Gobi Glie's Starship}}</ref> even though there are other moons visible in the episode itself<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> and other media had established Ryloth having three moons.<ref name="Resistance Reborn" />
